sentences.en: The results of the term examination were anything but satisfactory.
sentences.zh: 学期考试的结果远不能令人满意。

sentences.en: Mr White punished the boy for cheating on the examination.
sentences.zh: 怀特先生因为这个男孩在考试中作弊而惩罚了他。

sentences.en: The result of the examination fell short of our expectations.
sentences.zh: 考试结果没有达到我们的预期。
